title: RadixArk raised a third less and sold a third more
caption: The memo says Inferact has 50% more capital. Shown together with the valuations, a sharper fact appears. Inferact's round was priced more richly on both axes. That is the capital-gap risk expressed as dilution rather than dollars.
source: RadixArk announcement, May 5, 2026 (Businesswire). Inferact announcement, January 22, 2026 (TechCrunch).
